closure_claim: Every federal income tax withheld amount reported in box 4 of a Form 1099-G furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form 1099-G box 4 only: it says nothing about box 1 unemployment compensation, box 2 state or local refunds, boxes 5-7 or 9, or other Schedule 1 items. Closed with members authorizes the sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
title: Form 1099-G box 4 statement items, tax year 2025
